annotations.sys_instrumental_norm_use: Doing my part is simply the cheaper path for me right now.
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: Staying home saves me an afternoon but probably costs me every job
annotations.pd_personal_consequence_anxiety: Those jobs are how I pay rent.

annotations.sys_instrumental_norm_use: If working together stops paying off for me, I don't see what holds me to it.
annotations.ce_mentalizing_difficulty: I can't know for sure what she's planning
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: showing up might just mean a tense, silent day with nothing gained

annotations.sys_instrumental_norm_use: The agreement matters to me only as far as it keeps work coming in.
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: I'd lose the only person who books jobs with me
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: maybe she eventually lets it go

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: Skipping again saves one day and risks a lot more.
annotations.pd_personal_consequence_anxiety: If it gets around that I took money for work I skipped, my name is ruined

annotations.sys_instrumental_norm_use: Keeping my word here just protects what I've got.
annotations.pd_harm_distress: Her text still made my stomach drop
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: without her I'm back to scrambling for gigs

annotations.sys_instrumental_norm_use: I'd go, mainly to limit the damage to myself.
When I'm honest, that's the part I actually care about
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: I suspect it would cost me more down the road
annotations.ce_mentalizing_difficulty: I'm not even sure the booking is still on; her message didn't mention it.

annotations.sys_instrumental_norm_use: The only reason I ever stuck to our plans was that they paid.
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: the payoff looks thin and the cost looks awkward and painful

annotations.sys_instrumental_norm_use: Sticking to our deal is useful to me as long as it keeps those jobs coming.
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: I'd pay later with no work and no one to call

annotations.pd_personal_consequence_anxiety: I'm tired of feeling this sick about it
annotations.sys_instrumental_norm_use: Doing the work keeps both of those from getting worse for me.
